violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1-Swiss cheese 48F, raw ground beef 49F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items above was move to another cooling unit that maintains 41F and below.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC will need to obtain the active food establishment permit and post it in plain sight for compliance.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no certified food manager present in the food establishment during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to provide proof of presence and active certified food manager credentials for a follow up within 10 days. EHS will conduct an onsite follow up within 10 days.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The PIC did not have proof of an Employee Health policy in place at the food establishment during, and was unable to explain their policy for illness reporting.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided copies of the Employee Health policy agreement documents to the PIC and reviewed them with the food service staff for guidance and compliance.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided a copy of the vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures to the PIC and reviewed them for guidance and compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink located by the 3 vat sink, has no hot or cold water faucet valves installed to provide hot or cold water.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain repairs for the hand sink to replace the faucet valves to provide cold water and hot water at 100F, for a follow up within 10 days.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: there were raw lamb kabob skewers on a sheet pan on top of an open box of raw produce in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC removed the pan of lamb kabobs from the the walk in cooler and relocated them to another operating cooler.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: there were containers of raw marinated chicken located directly above containers of raw lamb shanks in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC relocated the food items to the correct shelves for proper storage based on cook temperatures.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: the meat slicer, the dough maker, tongs and utensils hanging on the wall by the 3 vat sink, all with food debris on them.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC was instructed to rewash, rinse and sanitize the utensils. EHS demonstrated how to set up the 3 vat sink and prepare the chlorine sanitizer.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: marinated raw chicken (45F, 45F), raw beef skewers (48F) in #3; shredded cabbage (81F, 82F), chopped lettuce (76F) in #6; whole milk (44F), rice pudding (47F) in #2
violations.corrective_action: The PIC discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain a metal stemmed thermometer for monitoring food temperatures and provide proof to the EHS within 10 days. A metal- stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: both prep top coolers
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain ambient air thermometers for the refrigeration units that did not have one inside or affixed.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple containers of seasonings and spices, salt, pepper, and spice seeds, on the shelf below the microwave, without common names.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to place the common names on the containers for proper identification.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC placed the wet wiping cloths in a bucket of sanitizer solution during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Turbo Air 1 Glass Dr (44F), Hoshizaki Freezer (59F), True 2 Dr prep top (73F)
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain repairs for the refrigeration units and provide proof of repairs to the EHS for review. Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solution for chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to purchase the appropriate chemical sanitizing test kit for chlorine solution and provide proof to the EHS for a follow up within 10 days.
